Cloudflare Introduces Post-Quantum Support for Geographically Fenced Key Manager

2026-10-27 · AI-assisted, source-attributed report

According to Cloudflare, the company has announced a new post-quantum GeoKey Manager designed to protect geographically fenced decryption keys from harvest now, decrypt later attacks.

Cloudflare explains that it redesigned its cryptography stack to support strict data sovereignty in a post-quantum world. The new offering ensures that sensitive, geographically restricted keys maintain security against advanced threats that could leverage future quantum computing capabilities.

Original source: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management
